question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should only the generic route-registration safety seam land in core while the channel is published externally?
rationale: Existing plugin seams support most of the channel, current main distributes the adjacent SMS integration separately, and the remaining core change is a generic API decision with compatibility implications.

options.title: External plugin plus core seam
options.body: Extract and review the generic registration-result contract in core, then publish the corrected RCS channel through the external plugin path.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept the complete channel into core after correcting provider contracts, obtaining dependency approval, resolving conflicts, and supplying live-provider proof.

options.title: Decline first-class RCS
options.body: Retain current SMS handling of inbound RCS-prefixed addresses without adding a separately operated RCS channel.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus core seam
recommendation.body: Extract and review the generic registration-result contract in core, then publish the corrected RCS channel through the external plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent Twilio SMS channel history makes this the strongest available owner for the bundling and API-boundary decision.
